# Know what a Faire order leaves after the first-order fee.

> Free Faire wholesale fee calculator for brands: net payout after 15% commission, the $10 new-customer fee, and payout-speed processing.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
